// FIXED delivery template (template-fill, no AI). Builds the tap-to-send wa.me link.
const g = $('Prepare').item.json;
const who = (g.owner_first_name && g.owner_first_name.length) ? g.owner_first_name : g.business_name;
const text = [
  who + ', sorted — here\'s your booking setup, two links:',
  '',
  'Your booking page (share this or pop it in your bio):',
  g.booking_url,
  '',
  'Your admin app (just for you):',
  g.admin_url,
  'PIN: ' + g.pin,
  '',
  'Open the admin link on your phone and tap "Add to Home Screen" — it installs like an app. That\'s where every booking lands, and where you can change your services, prices and hours yourself anytime.',
  '',
  'I\'ve added some standard ' + g.niche + ' services to start you off — go in and make them yours.',
  '',
  'The only catch, like I said — once you\'ve had a play and you\'re happy, a quick Google review for Streamline Automations. And a follow on @streamline_automations if you\'re feeling generous.',
  '',
  'Have a look and tell me what you think.',
  '',
  '— Christiaan from Streamline'
].join('\n');
const waLink = g.lead_phone ? ('https://wa.me/' + g.lead_phone + '?text=' + encodeURIComponent(text)) : '';
const summary = [
  'DELIVERY ready for ' + g.business_name + (g.lead_phone ? ' (+' + g.lead_phone + ')' : ' (NO PHONE)'),
  'Booking: ' + g.booking_url,
  'Admin: ' + g.admin_url + '  PIN ' + g.pin,
  '',
  'Tap to send the delivery message:',
  '',
  text
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { prospect_id: g.prospect_id, business_name: g.business_name, draft_text: text, waLink, summary, lead_phone: g.lead_phone } }];
